reference_probability.scope: Ranks/probabilities are in the independent CPU reference distribution at the shared prefix; native first-divergence logits are not retained

incident.error: ValueError('corrected target differs from independent CPU reference; stop remaining requests')

limitations: This verifies retained request trajectories and closed-owner metadata only; no state.bundle payload was read.
Mismatch request has no guaranteed final target dump; previous matched captures remain preserved but unverified here.
First divergent prediction has a shared prefix; later free-running logits do not. A new one-next-token replay needs separate root admission.
